notes.title: Boss Rush challenge update FINAL!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The final challenge update is here! Just in time for the hollidays! This last challenge is called Boss Rush! In Boss Rush you will have to go toe to toe with every boss from the Main Dream. Just watch out because one mess up will send you back to the start. Can you beat each boss without messing up? Find out today with the Boss Rush challenge update! 


This is the final update I have had planned for L.S.D. Maybe some day ill add more content if people ask but for now i need to move on to bigger and better things. The next game in the Lucid Dream series will be comming some time in 2023 if things go smoothly. I hope you all enjoy Lucid Dream Simulator! Come join the discord to get updates on the next game. The most ill say now is the title of the next game is L.D.S. Lucid Dream Shooter! Thats all for now and i hope you all have a great new year! Goodbye for now.

notes.title: WELCOME TO MAZE CRAZE!
notes.notes:
Hello people! Today I gift you all with another free update! MAZE CRAZE! Maze Craze is the second part of the challenge update! This challenge brings you to a crazy maze full of wonder and mystery. Can you escape the maze? Find out TODAY! 

Update includes: 
- Maze Craze challenge update
-Few minor changes to Main Dream for quality of life
-Few minor changes to Mini Dream for quality of life

Other news: 
-Third challenge update expected to arrive Q4 2022,
-New title to be released 2023! 
-Clips of new game will be posted in the discord soon so join and take a look! 
-I got a new EUC and I am so stoked to ride it!


Dev note:
  Hope you all having fun with L.D.S. Now that challenge update 2 is done I can go back to development on my next game. Do not worry this will not stop more content updates to L.D.S. The new game is finally started to look good! I spent around 5 months making new concepts and scraping. Such a good feeling to be done with it and can just move on to developing rather then concept. I really hope you guys take a look and give me some feedback on the discord. This next title I really want to shoot for the moon and exceed all my expectations. Other then game news I got a new Electric Unicycle coming in the mail and I cant wait to ride the living balls out of it. Have a fun summer sale and hope you all enjoy the new update! Till next time!

notes.title: Challenge update number one!
notes.notes: Hello everyone! We bring you the first of more updates to come called: "The Challenge" update! This update brings our first challenge, Tower! Tower is a series of challenges where failure may result in falling to the bottom and having to start over! These challenges are all new and will bring even more content to Lucid Dream Simulator. This update is mainly for our PC players but can still be played in VR. Stay tuned for more challenges to come! Enjoy the new content!

notes.title: New FREE content has come to Lucid Dream Simulator!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40669174/f574c25e85ddd914e69af9e3660ae896651e848f.png[/img]


Hello Everyone! 

    I'm here to first thank all who supported R3Games with purchasing LDS. The only way we knew how to show our gratitude was to give back with more content! This content is called the Mini Dream update. This brings a new explorable path that is found in the LDS main menu. There are more puzzles, enemies and friends as well as a whole bunch of new levels waiting to be explored. WARNING! This content is considered to be a more hardcore version of the game. The worlds will be more challenging than the main title and escape may not be possible for some. In addition to this new update, I would like to announce that a new VR-only title is in the works. This title will release in 2022. More information will be dropped over time in our Discord page that you can find via the "visit the website" link on the LDS store page. Our Discord is also used for bug reports, so any bugs that you find, feel free to reach out to the team via our Discord page. Thank you all again and enjoy the new update!

notes.title: VR Movement Speed Overhaul
notes.notes:
This update will only effect VR game play and not PC gameplay! 

Hello everyone! I just want to start off by saying thank you to everyone who has purchased LDS! I am very happy to see people are enjoying and talking about the game. It has come to my attention that there are still some more issues with VR players. The main issue was the movement and how it was too slow. In this update all VR players will notice changes to the movement in levels. 

For example, some areas, such as underwater, have slower movement to simulate walking underwater. As for areas like the Boss Rooms, the movement speed has increased to make the area more engaging and fun to play. 

Other smaller fixes have been implemented as well to help smooth out the playing experience. One example of this was the issue of spawning into a scene and instantly dropping to the floor as if you were hovering and then falling. This issue has been resolved. Again, all of the issues addressed in this update pertain to VR. To my current knowledge there are no issues on PC, but if they do come to my attention, rest assured they will be resolved.

If you ever come across any annoying bugs, issues, or features please just let me know. The main way to contact me is via Discord. Click on the "Visit the Website" link via the Steam Store page and let me know! Thanks again to everyone and have fun playing!
